lines.text: Hushai the Archite greets Absalom as king and promises to serve him as he served David.
Ahithophel advises Absalom to sleep with his father's concubines, and Absalom does so in the sight of all Israel.
Ahithophel asks for twelve thousand men to pursue David that night and strike down only the priests.
Hushai advises gathering all Israel with Joab leading them into battle, and Absalom prefers his advice because the LORD purposed it.

wrong_details.true: Absalom himself leading them into battle

lines.text: Jonathan and Ahimaaz hide in a well at Bahurim, then warn David, who crosses the Jordan by daybreak.
